text: cast iron bacon press. I have a non stick grill pan.  But once in awhile you want to "grill" something that needs weight to really make contact with the pan. features: Includes 1 steak weight/bacon press with wooden handle

description: Making sure that food cooks evenly is very important in every kitchen. Ensure that your meats cook evenly by purchasing one of our steak weights. Not only will the food cook faster and more evenly, it will also allow for healthier cooking by squeezing extraneous fat from meat as it cooks. Made from cast aluminum, the heat transfer process will initiate immediately, while the wooden handle will keep your hands cool during use.
